investor.title: The Psychology of Money
investor.author: Morgan Housel
investor.why: Pinned anchor; establishes the behavioral and psychological foundation every investor needs before touching a single financial concept.

investor.title: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing
investor.author: John C. Bogle
investor.why: Pinned anchor; translates psychology into a concrete, low-cost indexing philosophy and introduces core portfolio concepts.

investor.title: A Random Walk Down Wall Street
investor.author: Burton Gordon Malkiel
investor.why: High review-count classic that deepens market-efficiency theory and adds empirical evidence for passive investing, broadening what Bogle introduced.

investor.title: The Bogleheads' Guide to Investing
investor.author: Mel Lindauer, Taylor Larimore, Michael LeBoeuf
investor.why: Accessible, highly-reviewed practical guide that moves from theory to real-world account setup, tax efficiency, and inflation awareness.

investor.title: The Intelligent Investor
investor.author: Benjamin Graham
investor.why: Foundational value-investing text that introduces security analysis, margin of safety, and the Mr. Market allegory as a counterpoint to pure indexing.

investor.title: One Up On Wall Street
investor.author: Peter Lynch
investor.why: Approachable growth-investing perspective that teaches readers to identify great businesses using everyday observations, complementing Graham's defensive approach.

investor.title: The Most Important Thing
investor.author: Howard Marks
investor.why: Elevates risk thinking from avoidance to active calibration, introducing market cycles and the concept of price relative to value.

investor.title: Stocks for the Long Run: The Definitive Guide to Financial Market Returns & Long-Term Investment Strategies, Sixth Edition
investor.author: Jeremy J. Siegel
investor.why: Provides long-horizon empirical data across asset classes and macro variables, grounding the investor in historical return patterns and global context.

investor.title: Pioneering Portfolio Management
investor.author: David F. Swensen
investor.why: Introduces endowment-style portfolio construction with true diversification across uncorrelated asset classes, adding institutional-level thinking.

investor.title: Antifragile
investor.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
investor.why: Capstone philosophical work that reframes risk as opportunity under uncertainty, teaching the advanced investor to build portfolios that benefit from volatility.

trader.title: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
trader.author: John J. Murphy
trader.why: Pinned anchor; the definitive encyclopedic reference that establishes the full vocabulary and toolkit of technical analysis.

trader.title: Japanese Candlestick Charting Techniques
trader.author: Steve Nison
trader.why: Highly popular and accessible deep-dive into candlestick patterns that adds a precise price-action language missing from Murphy's broader survey.

trader.title: Trading in the Zone
trader.author: Mark Douglas
trader.why: Establishes the psychological operating system required before live trading, addressing the mental pitfalls that cause most traders to fail.

trader.title: Market Wizards
trader.author: Jack D. Schwager
trader.why: Widely-read interviews with elite traders crystallize diverse real-world strategies and reinforce that risk management and discipline trump any single setup.

trader.title: The Art and Science of Technical Analysis
trader.author: Adam Grimes
trader.why: Bridges pattern recognition and statistical thinking, teaching traders to test and validate setups rather than rely on folklore.

trader.title: Trade Your Way to Financial Freedom
trader.author: Van K. Tharp
trader.why: Introduces a rigorous framework for designing, sizing, and evaluating complete trading systems, elevating craft beyond individual setups.

trader.title: Come Into My Trading Room
trader.author: Alexander Elder
trader.why: Integrates technical signals, money management, and trader psychology into a unified daily operating routine with concrete rules.

trader.title: Trading and Exchanges
trader.author: Larry Harris
trader.why: Reveals the microstructure layer beneath price charts, teaching traders how orders interact with market makers and why execution quality matters.

trader.title: Quantitative Trading
trader.author: Ernie Chan
trader.why: Introduces systematic and quantitative methods for building, testing, and deploying automated strategies, extending discretionary skills into code-driven frameworks.

trader.title: The Alchemy of Finance
trader.author: George Soros
trader.why: Capstone macro-philosophical work that teaches advanced traders to think in feedback loops and trade regime shifts at the highest level of abstraction.
